title: 第二十一章   死海、星辰学院
content_zh:
傍晚的小山村处处散发着安静祥和的气息，琼霄慵懒的靠在座椅上，欣赏着晚霞的美丽，入学考试已经结束了几天，他终于如愿以偿的成为了星辰学院的学生了。

    “孩子，再过几天，你就要前往星辰学院了吧！”琼霄悠闲着翘着腿，双眼迷糊之间忽然传来了苍老的声音，此刻陈伯早已结束了忙碌，在琼霄身旁坐了下来。

    “嗯嗯，再有几天，我就要走了！”琼霄缓缓的说道。

    几天后……

    炎城！

    告别了老人，琼霄来到了指定地点，这里空荡荡的，没有一个人影，“难道星辰学院已经离开了？那我怎么办？

    “哼！”一声娇喝声突然从琼霄背后传来，琼霄迅速回头，一道娇躯在那里紧紧盯着他。

    “蓝湘学姐！你怎么在这里？”琼霄好奇的问道。

    “你说我怎么不能在这里？”蓝湘反问道。

    “额，行，我说不过你，今天不是去星辰学院的日子么？怎么我没见一个人影？”琼霄无奈的问道。

    “队伍几天前就已经离开！你被淘汰了！”蓝湘面无表情的说道。

    “额……”

    “骗你的，不过队伍的确已经离开了，现在的确只剩下你一个人了！”蓝湘戏谑道。

    “为什么他们不等人齐就离开了？”琼霄气急道。

    “咯咯！”蓝湘娇笑着。

    “你笑什么？”琼霄隐隐有些怒道。

    “哟！生气了？本姑娘给你放假，让你在家休息几天再来，不好啊！亏本姑娘还专门留下来等你一个人！”蓝湘美目中闪过一丝的委屈。

    “额…这个…”

    看到琼霄不好意思的挠头，蓝湘心中一乐，“没想到你还会有这一面啊！”蓝湘掩嘴笑道。

    “你！”琼霄话从将要从口中而出，又被他生生咽了下去。

    “你什么你！真小气，还不赶紧走？”蓝湘嘟着嘴说道。
content_en:
In the evening, the small mountain village exuded a quiet and peaceful atmosphere. Qiong Xiao leaned lazily on his seat and admired the beauty of the sunset. The entrance exam had been over for a few days, and he finally got his wish and became a student of Star College.

"My child, in a few days, you will go to Xingchen Academy!" Qiong Xiao crossed his legs leisurely, and suddenly an old voice came from his eyes. At this moment, Uncle Chen had already finished his busy work and sat down next to Qiong Xiao.

"Hmm, I'll be leaving in a few days!" Qiong Xiao said slowly.

A few days later…

Yancheng!

After bidding farewell to the old man, Qiong Xiao came to the designated place. It was empty and there was no one around. "Has the Star Academy already left? What should I do?"

"Hmph!"A shout suddenly came from behind Qiong Xiao. Qiong Xiao quickly turned around, where a delicate figure stared at him closely.

"Senior Lan Xiang!Why are you here?Qiong Xiao asked curiously.

"Why can't you be here?Lan Xiang asked rhetorically.

"Well, okay, I can't help you. Isn't today the day to go to Star Academy?Why didn't I see anyone?Qiong Xiao asked helplessly.

“The team left a few days ago!You are eliminated!Lan Xiang said expressionlessly.

"Um..."

"I'm lying to you, but the team has indeed left, and you are indeed the only one left now!" Lan Xiang joked.

“Why did they leave before everyone was gathered?Qiong Xiao said angrily.

“Giggle!" Lan Xiang smiled delicately.

"What are you laughing at?"Qiong Xiao said slightly angrily.

"Yo!Angry?This girl will give you a holiday and let you rest at home for a few days before coming back. That’s not good!The girl who lost money even stayed here to wait for you alone!"A trace of grievance flashed in Lan Xiang's beautiful eyes.

"Um...this..."

Seeing Qiong Xiao scratching her head in embarrassment, Lan Xiang felt happy, "I didn't expect you would have this side!" Lan Xiang covered his mouth and smiled.

"You!"Qiong Xiao's words came out of his mouth, and he swallowed them alive.

"What are you!You're so stingy, why don't you leave quickly?Lan Xiang pouted and said.
